status: Research recorded; Toolbar/Group/selection responsibility split selected. Detailed interfaces and acceptance remain open.

userDecision.text: Separate responsibilities: generic Group arranges children; Toolbar identifies related controls and owns coordinated keyboard movement; selection controls retain selected-value and form responsibility. Compose these roles, rather than have two focus/selection owners.
